experiment.name: simulation
experiment.description: Validation of Section 3.1: cancellation, random mixtures, and a homogeneous population with noise

simulation._note: One design for every condition of Table 1 and of the dispersion curve: four alternatives, a Gaussian response on the log-odds scale with dispersion sigma2, n_comparisons judgments per replicate. The stopping rule and the priors are not here; they live in config/mop_params.json.

cancellation.description: Opposite preferences cancel: the one-component model reads indifference, the mixture recovers both

general.description: Random ground truth; the mixture is never worse and is better where the truth has more than one component

noise.description: A fifth of the judgments are uniform noise; the mixture isolates them in a low-weight component
